prompt: Composition: Large event title, date and venue, then an unframed program table and direct booking action. Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Roboto; condensed heading with regular interface text. Use Spectrum 1-2: page #F9FBFA, text #1F292D, accent #1D2286, secondary surface #EFE7EB, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 36px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 32px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
